title: lewisia pygmaea var. sierrae
intro: Lewisia pygmaea var. sierrae, commonly known as Sierra Bitterroot, is a rare and endemic plant species native to the Sierra Nevada mountain range in California. It is known for its attractive, delicate flowers and succulent leaves. Sierra Bitterroot has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in soothing wounds and reducing infection. The bioactive constituents present in Sierra Bitterroot include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
